examples.name: Clearable with a real IconButton action
examples.jsx:
<TextField
  aria-label="Filter"
  value={value}
  onChange={(e) => setValue(e.target.value)}
  iconAfter={
    value ? (
      <IconButton appearance="subtle" shape="square" size="xs" aria-label="Clear" onClick={() => setValue('')}>
        <CloseIcon />
      </IconButton>
    ) : null
  }
/>

antiExamples.name: No accessible name
antiExamples.reason: Placeholder text is not an accessible label - pair with a native label[htmlFor] or add aria-label.

antiExamples.name: Multi-line content
antiExamples.reason: Text Field has no textarea mode - it's for a single line of text.

antiExamples.name: Fixed set of options
antiExamples.reason: Use Select when the value comes from a fixed set of options instead of free text.

antiExamples.name: Faking a clear button with a bare icon
antiExamples.reason: A bare icon with a click handler is not a real, focusable, labeled control. Use a real IconButton (appearance=subtle, shape=square) instead.
